shortDesc: Wayfarer layout: two columns, main content plus a sidebar (right by default), stacking to one column on phones with the sidebar after the main content. Put the page's primary components in the default slot and supporting ones in slot="aside".

props.name: aside-width
props.description: Sidebar width: narrow (280px, default) or wide (360px).

props.name: sticky
props.description: Present to keep the sidebar in view while the main column scrolls.
